description: SLSQP and DE yaw optimization on gray-box wake model
note: The power_output function has a hard threshold at u_rated (11.4 m/s): for u > u_rated it returns P_rated regardless of yaw, making yaw "free" for upstream turbines. This creates a discontinuity in the optimization landscape: gains jump from ~4% at v=11.4 to ~9% at v=11.5.
